text:
nora: FYI — we have an alert from customer Signalize: unexpected jump in embedding bill for Apr 2nd. Roughly +380k tokens vs baseline. No product changes reported on their side. Can finance triage?
sam: Dropping a sample request_id from their support ticket: SIG_4521 at 2028-04-02T03:05:12Z. I'll query embedding_events.
diego: Quick scan shows multiple entries for same client_request_id but the user_agent shows `sdk-go/4.0.0` which started shipping last week. Some events have null idempotency_key and vector_hash lengths vary (32 vs 16). Snippet:
```sql
SELECT client_request_id, vector_hash, count(*)
FROM embedding_events
WHERE client_request_id = 'SIG_4521'
GROUP BY client_request_id, vector_hash;
```
-- returns two rows for SIG_4521, counts 2 and 1
priya: billing-bot shows dedupe-failure-rate for customer=Signalize over last 24h = 0.78% (>0.5% threshold).
billing-bot: Alert created: DEDUPE-ALERT-5591.
nora: Is the root cause SDK truncating the vector hash or removing idempotency?
sam: Both, it seems. SDK batch path moved to `sha1` truncated at 16 chars in v4.0.0 for performance. Our ingestion dedupe logic expected full sha256(64) or an explicit idempotency key.
diego: Proposed steps: (A) patch ingestion to treat short vector_hash as "possibly truncated" and attempt grouping by (customer_id, request_id, model, tokens) within +/- 5s; (B) add ingestion header parsing for `x-sdk-req-id` — the new SDK header; (C) run backfill dry-run to quantify.
priya: Finance needs an estimate for credit amount. Current price tier for Signalize is $0.00011/token.
sam: Running aggregation fast-mode. Query used:
```sql
WITH dup AS (
  SELECT customer_id, client_request_id, count(*) cnt, sum(tokens) toks
  FROM embedding_events
  WHERE event_time >= '2028-04-02'::date AND customer_id = 'signalize'
  GROUP BY customer_id, client_request_id
  HAVING count(*) > 1
)
SELECT sum((cnt - 1) * (toks / cnt)) as dup_tokens FROM dup;
```
-- result (dry-run): 381,720 duplicate tokens
priya: That equates to ~$42.0 at $0.00011/token. Finance needs memo text and confirmation to proceed.
nora: Also include a customer-facing note: cause = SDK v4.0.0 vector_hash truncation + missing idempotency header; remediation = we've applied a one-time credit and recommend upgrading to sdk-go 4.0.1 which restores full hash.
diego: I've queued parser patch in branch `ingest/accept-x-sdk-req-id` and will deploy a canary. Parser will now accept `x-sdk-req-id` and populate idempotency_key. Also changing vector_hash storage to full 64-char where available.
billing-bot: Backfill job created BF-2028-0945 (dry-run completed). Potential ledger impact: -$41.99. Requires manual approval to proceed.
priya: Approved the ledger adjustment amount and memo: "dedupe-backfill: sdk-go v4.0.0 truncated vector_hash (2028-04-02)". Please attach the CSV of affected request_ids.
sam: Uploaded CSV to ticket and set backfill to run in 15 minutes. Also added an automated dashboard metric `billing.dedupe_rate_by_sdk` to track moving forward.
nora: Good. Who will own customer comms?
priya: I'll draft the email and include the account manager + SDK team. We'll mark credit as one-time goodwill and include upgrade instructions.
sdk-team: We'll follow up with a patch that ensures future releases preserve full vector hash and emits `x-sdk-req-id` consistently. Also adding release note.
diego: After backfill, please monitor invoice reconciliation for Signalize and mark their invoice as adjusted.
billing-bot: Backfill BF-2028-0945 completed. Ledger entries created and queued.
priya: Confirmed ledger lines posted. Notifying Signalize now.
nora: Closing thread — add short postmortem to internal docs and a checklist for ingestion compatibility testing on SDK updates. Thanks everyone.
